Subject: Ignite POC: readiness checklist & next-week momentum

Hi Ben / Sofia — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum into the POC: 

Summary of what we agreed:
- Goal: validate intent extraction + reranking on Ignite support corpus and measure latency/quality under representative load.
- Success criteria (initial):
  • Intent accuracy (F1) >= 0.82 on your labeled sample
  • Rerank NDCG@10 improvement >= 12% vs baseline
  • 95th perc. query latency < 300ms at steady-state test load (see test plan)
  • Ingest ~10k help articles + 50k short tickets for retrieval benchmarking

Immediate asks / owners (please confirm):
- Ignite: provide sample corpus + label file (Ben)
- Ignite: infra contact for SSO / firewall (Sofia)
- Redwood: dataset ingestion & mapping (Marissa)
- Redwood: telemetry & eval dashboards (Dylan)
- Redwood: infra / GPU quota check (Neha)

Proposed high-level timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): get sample data, confirm infra access, finalize success criteria (Sep 7–11)
- Week 1: ingest data + baseline run (Sep 14–18)
- Week 2: tune model/quantization and run evals (Sep 21–25)
- Week 3: wrap-up, joint review, next-step recommendations (Sep 28–30)

Attachments: ignite_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (draft criteria & measurement plan)

Can you confirm owners and call out any additional must-have criteria by EOD tomorrow? If everything looks good we'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next Wednesday (9/15) to hand off access and start ingestion.

Thanks,
Marcus

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap, this matches our notes. A couple additions from our side: 

- Success criteria tweaks:
  • Let's include a relevance metric target: NDCG@5 >= 0.60 (so we can see short-list improvement)
  • Add a regression threshold for precision @1 (not drop more than 3% vs current).
- Security/SSO: we need to confirm SAML metadata + a list of source IPs to allow in the firewall. I'll share the infra contact in a separate email (Sofia will loop him in).
- Data: we'll deliver an initial 2k labeled set by Sep 10, and the larger export by Sep 13.

I attached a short environment requirements doc (ignite_env_requirements.docx) that lists sample S3 paths, IP allowlist, and expected formats.
